messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — ran a 3-model GPTQ smokechain this morning (Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B) across AWQ/GPTQ/INT8 profiles. posting highlights.
Priya: awesome, curious about accuracy delta vs FP16 and any KV problems.
Alex: TL;DR: GPTQ stable for Llama & Qwen on commonsense/NLI tasks (<=1.2% mean EM drop). Mistral shows a ~3.8% EM hit with naive per-tensor GPTQ; AWQ did better (~1.5%).
Tomo: can you share the eval sets and exact metrics? (EM, F1, perplexity) or just summary for now
Alex: summary first: datasets — HellaSwag, PIQA, ANLI-R1, Lambada (long-context). Metrics — EM for ANLI/Hella, accuracy for PIQA, and perplexity on Lambada.
Alex: numbers: Llama-2-13B: FP16 baseline ANLI EM 62.4; GPTQ EM 61.1 (-1.3), AWQ EM 61.9 (-0.5). PIQA accuracy FP16 84.2; GPTQ 83.5 (-0.7). Lambada ppl FP16 9.8; GPTQ 10.1 (small increase).
Priya: that's good for Llama. Qwen?
Alex: Qwen-7B: FP16 ANLI EM 58.0; GPTQ 57.0 (-1.0); AWQ 57.6 (-0.4). PIQA FP16 81.0; GPTQ 80.1 (-0.9). KV cache behavior: Qwen had no notable KV regressions with our GPTQ pipeline.
Eva: Mistral details pls
Alex: Mistral-7B: FP16 ANLI EM 63.5; GPTQ (default per-tensor) 59.7 (-3.8) — big. AWQ tuned profiles regained most: AWQ 62.0 (-1.5). Lambada PPL for Mistral jumped from 8.7 -> 10.3 with naive GPTQ.
Marcos: any pattern on where Mistral lost? instruction-following? long-context?
Alex: regressions concentrated on long-generation tasks (Lambada) and some multi-hop commonsense. Likely sensitive attention + layernorm handling in the naive pipeline.
Tomo: runtime/throughput numbers for deploy planning?
Alex: synthetic qps on A100-40G per replica (seq len 512): FP16 Llama-13B baseline 120 tok/s, GPTQ binary ~150 tok/s (due to smaller kernel memory working set), AWQ ~145. On T4: FP16 45 tok/s, GPTQ 62 tok/s.
Priya: latency tail behavior?
Alex: p95 increases modestly for GPTQ on A100 (FP16 82ms p95 -> GPTQ 78ms p95). On T4, p95 improved a bit due to cache fits (128ms -> 110ms).
Bakebot: auto-summary: 3 models, 3 quant profiles. Primary signals: Llama/Qwen accept GPTQ with minor quality delta; Mistral requires AWQ/tuned passes. Throughput gains consistent. KV cache regressions observed only for Mistral naive GPTQ.
Eva: ops ask: any special rollout profile recommended for Dedicated customers?
Marcos: propose staged rollout: canary (5% traffic) on Dedicated with AWQ enabled for Mistral family, full GPTQ allowed for Llama/Qwen after smoke test. Add comparison eval suite (our ANLI/PIQA/Lambada) as a release gate.
Tomo: +1. Also include a quick online AB with user-sim prompts for hallucination/regression detection.
Priya: action items?
Alex: (1) publish bake artifact: model+quant profile tarball + README (where to find per-layer stats) — due EOD tomorrow. (2) run extended Mistral AWQ sweep with layerwise perplexity logging — Priya + Eva. (3) Add KV regression unit test to bakebot pipeline — Tomo.
Marcos: I'll draft the rollout doc and canary config for Dedicated. sharing next PR.
Alex: uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-bakes/3751234567/ now. example eval snippet:
```
ANLI | model          | profile | EM
FP16 | mistral-7b     | fp16    | 63.5
GPTQ | mistral-7b     | gptq    | 59.7
AWQ  | mistral-7b     | awq     | 62.0
```
Priya: perfect. let's keep thread for updates. thanks all :rocket:
